summary: Payments API latency increased after checkout release.
root_cause: New fraud enrichment call added synchronous gateway dependency.
resolution: Rolled back release and moved enrichment to async workflow.

summary: Consumer lag grew after partition skew.
root_cause: Hot customer key concentrated events on one partition.
resolution: Increased partitions and deployed key salting for high-volume tenants.

summary: Search errors rose after index schema migration.
root_cause: New analyzer rejected legacy tokens during refresh.
resolution: Reverted analyzer migration and paused index refresh.

summary: Database latency spiked during reporting job.
root_cause: Long-running report query held locks on hot table.
resolution: Cancelled query and moved report to read replica.
